name: Ten days of unpaid leave: below the threshold, insurance still due
source: synthetic — replace with anonymised real cases
derivation: 22 working days in the month, 10 of them unpaid leave, so 12 paid (paidDaysCenti 1200, unpaidDaysCenti 1000).
Insurance: uncovered working days = 22 - 12 = 10, below the threshold of 14, so the month is contributed for in full on 30,000,000.
Employee insurance 3,150,000 as in the full-month case — the contribution does not follow the salary down.
